facts.fact: Djibouti's president officially launched the Mobile ID platform on 9 February 2026, whose authentication combines the national ID card number and a digital fingerprint, per Digital Business Africa.
Digital Business Africa reports Mobile ID launched in Djibouti with three functions: payment authorisation, authentication and electronic signature.

DJI.note: No civil register to ID link stated.
Civil status is named only in a presidential quote about uses of digital ID; no register system stated.
A general remark that cybersecurity is part of sovereignty; no strategy, rule or hosting stated.
An e-signature function on a platform is stated, no law.
No count or share of people enrolled stated.
Nothing on a number at birth.
Who operates or owns the ID system is not stated.
No public register keyed on the ID number stated.
Mobile ID checks a fingerprint at authentication; no statement of ID issuance, enrolment de-duplication or certification.
